property_summary: A coordinator-parameter update (updateMaintenance) must succeed if and only if the caller is the product's coordinator owner, and a successful call must store exactly the requested maintenance value; the inverted check makes the owner's call revert while any non-owner's call succeeds and mutates maintenance(), violating this rule.
change_summary: Invert the ownership check so that the coordinator owner's call reverts while non-owners can perform the update.
